episodes.synopsis: Ayato Amagiri is a scholarship transfer student. What awaits him at the Seidoukan Academy?
episodes.title: Glühen Ros

episodes.synopsis: Since Julis is indebted to Ayato, she offers to show him around the academy. Little does she know that she is not the only one who wants to be Ayato's tour guide!
episodes.title: Ser=Versta

episodes.synopsis: Julis keeps her promise and shows Ayato around the city on their day off. Finally, he gets to know the princess better.
episodes.title: A Holiday for Two

episodes.synopsis: Julis runs off after reading a letter. Ayato goes after her, worried that she might be in danger.
episodes.title: Unshackled

episodes.synopsis: Since Seidoukan and Allekant agreed to co-develop a new type of Lux, a few representatives from Allekant Academy visit the Seidoukan training room. Julis asks Ayato not to get into any duels before the Phoenix Festa!
episodes.title: Lightning Blade Speed

episodes.synopsis: Julis is still angry at Ayato after he went against her word, and Ayato learns more about the current rank #1 holder, Kirin Toudou.
episodes.title: The True Face of the Girl

episodes.synopsis: After fighting the monsters, what other dangers await Ayato and Kirin?
episodes.title: Decisions and Duels

episodes.synopsis: Saya and Kirin have teamed up for the upcoming Phoenix Festa. By the look of things, they need to spend some more time together. The girls skip practice to socialize more. Surprisingly, there is something Kirin would like Saya to do for her...
episodes.title: A Holiday for Two, Part 2

episodes.synopsis: The Phoenix Festa has finally begun. However, there are some important changes to the regulations this time. Ayato and Julis are determined to give it all they have got!
episodes.title: The Phoenix Festa

episodes.synopsis: Here comes a new challenger in the Phoenix Festa! The Tyrant Vampire Princess Irene Urzaiz seems to be unstoppable… and her sole target is Ayato!
episodes.title: The Tyrant Vampire Princess

episodes.synopsis: Ayato searches for Saya per Kirin's request but runs into Priscilla, the Sister of The Tyrant Vampire Princess. Also, Claudia has a secret.
episodes.title: Power and Its Price

episodes.synopsis: The final battle, Ayato and Julis versus The Urzaiz Sisters. Who will win?
episodes.title: The Gravisheath
